page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, meaning there is one thread per core without hyperthreading. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 94489 GB of HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers high resource density for workloads requiring massive local data storage without the premium cost associated with solid-state drives. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale data warehousing, log analysis, distributed file systems, and big data processing frameworks that rely on sequential read and write operations across large datasets.
